Name: Minakie's Chicken Overhaul
Author: Minakie
Description:
[i][left][u][s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png[/img]﻿[/s][/u]
[/left][/i]
[size=3]I found some [/size][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-free-to-edit-wips-crucifigos-livestock-semi-realistic-animal-replacers.109480/]free to use livestock bases[/url][size=3] and decided to use them to recolor my chickens. The [/size][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/elles-barn-and-coop-animal-replacements.126156/]baby chicks[/url][size=3] that I thought were from the vanilla game are from Elle after all. No wonder I thought they were so cute.[/size]
[size=3]I still want to add an additional chicken color. I may or may not work on more animals in the future.[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]But, given my chronic depression, probably not. At least not anytime soon.[/spoiler]

[/size]
[center][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/918-0-1486919240.png[/img][/size][/center]

[size=2][s]A backup of the vanilla chickens files is provided with this mod, so don't worry about losing them if you want them back later.

[b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b]

Copy-paste the Content folder into your "...\Stardew Valley" main folder and, when prompted, let it override.[/s][/size]

[size=3][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/SKDkt5hJ/update.png[/img]﻿
[/u]
This mod is now updated to work with Content Patcher, so it will no longer replace any game files.[/size]
